name: Souda Manabu
source:
A young man obsessed with online gaming. He is a guild leader, and so skilled that he is worshipped as a god in the game world, something which he takes tremendous pride in.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
